descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Cultural Heritage Editorial for KYOTO SAKURA SS26 kimono drop. Subject: a Japanese woman 27, of Kyoto-Kamigata lineage, glossy black hair dressed in a classic shimada-style bun held by a bekkō kushi comb and kanzashi hairpin; Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush across cheekbones and temples in dappled backlight. Wardrobe: a formal hōmongi-cut silk kimono in kimono-indigo #1E2E5A base with all-over kimono-cream-pattern #F2E8D6 yūzen-dyed seigaiha wave and karahana floral motifs along hem and sleeves, a wide obi-gold #C89848 nishijin-ori brocade fukuro obi tied in a taiko drum knot at the back, a cream shibori obiage sash, a pale-green obijime cord, white tabi socks with zōri sandals. Setting: a sakura-pink #F2C6CE somei-yoshino cherry blossom tree in full bloom overhead at the Philosopher's Path, petals drifting in slow motion, a low stone lantern blurred behind. Composition: Rule of Thirds torso 44% x 48% y, hero vertical, Eye-Level 0°, body 3/4 turned, one hand lightly holding a closed bangasa-style umbrella, gaze softly upward contemplative. Camera: Sony A7R V · 85mm f/2.0 · 1/320s · ISO 200. Lighting: Backlit Cherry-Canopy Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — low spring sun camera-back 20° elevation through blossom canopy (key backlit petal-rim), 4×4ft silver bounce camera-front 1.5m (fill on face), 1×3ft strip rim camera-left 30° grazing obi gold brocade (rim highlighting nishijin), 4×4ft black flag below right to deepen kimono indigo. Material physics: yūzen hand-painted paste-resist dye bleed, nishijin-ori brocade raised gold-thread weft, silk-kimono drape weight, shibori-obiage pucker, sakura petal translucence. Color grade: Fuji Pro 400H emulation grain 4 +0.2 EV. Palette: kimono-indigo 26%, kimono-cream-pattern 22%, obi-gold 14%, sakura-pink 18%, skin-warm 20%. References: Mika Ninagawa Kyoto, Vogue Japan heritage, Hiroshi Sugimoto portraits. Exclude: harsh flash, plastic skin, AI hallucination artifacts, cropped extremities, muddy shadows.
